# FLX-7143: the next state is the state the forecasts were made on

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

`fluxsim forecast score --next` names the profile of the state after the one the bundle pins. A forecast scored against the state it was made on would be scored against what it already read, so a next state whose digest is the pinned profile's digest is refused, and nothing is scored or written. Pass the later release of the profile.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7143
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
